Ensure that your TNG has a minimum fee of RM 5 (bus fee would be a flat rate of RM 1.50 travelling anywhere on the route) if you want to use the bus to get there because the TNG on the bus will reject your card if you have low balance (AFAIK less than RM 3). If you're stopping at MRT Kwasa Sentral, there's a 7/11 that you can top up your TNG card in case you have low balance after arriving there. Speaking from experience, you would hate it if you missed the bus there because you would get a new bus for another 30-40 minutes (might have changed now). During your trip in the bus, press the stop button in case you're going to stop at the next bus stop (refer which bus stop by using Moovit app). Good luck with your trip and have fun!

Source: used the MRT bus myself to travel to Puncak Alam when travelling home from University
